causal: R2 matched dense GQA under both training recipes
practical: BM25 retrieval plus the same answer model as full-context
BM25 retrieval plus one larger public short-context answer model

freeze: Pin at least two working public comparators, including one near total footprint and one stronger/larger reference; freeze before final model selection. Reuse pinned MiniCPM5-2B identities where compatible. No current-best claim without release-era recheck.
rag: Use deterministic chunking, BM25 top-k and a fixed prompt; tune one bounded k/chunk grid on development only. Count indexing (one-time and amortized), retrieval, input/output tokens, generation, total memory and task latency. Give full-context and RAG the same source text and task/output budgets. No learned reranker needed for the first baseline.
matched_settings: Separate base versus instruct, total versus active/non-embedding parameters, trained tokens and teacher resources. Compare matched precision/backend where supported and label separately the best qualified deployment of each model. Do not handicap a comparator with an unoptimized reference path and claim universal speedup.
systems: Randomized interleaved warmed trials, at least five blocks, batch one plus a declared throughput workload, cold/warm cache and startup reported separately. Record hardware, software, memory ceiling, energy telemetry availability and quality at each operating point.
no_claims: GPU-hours across hardware as interchangeable FLOPs
full-context supremacy over retrieval on every task
